brand_identity.name: KINETIC NUTRITION
brand_identity.tagline: Pure Performance Engineering for Elite Athletes
brand_identity.vibe: Clean, light, ultra-premium, tactile-minimalist aesthetic with high-energy kinetic contrast.

color_palette.theme: Light Theme Default with High-Contrast Dark & Electric Accent
color_palette.contrast_rules: All text elements must strictly pass WCAG AA (4.5:1 min). Hover states must explicitly set hover:text-white or hover:text-slate-900 to ensure high readability.

scale_hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-none
scale_hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Scale with generous padding inside cards (p-6 to p-8) and container limits max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Grid with asymmetric spans for featured products and categories (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 lg:gap-8).
spacing_and_layout.header: Sticky navbar with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/85 z-50 border-b border-slate-100.

motion_and_animations.hero_reveal: Staggered line-by-line masked text reveal with opacity and slide-up y: [30, 0], duration: 0.8s, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]
motion_and_animations.category_circles: Hover scale transform scale-105 with subtle glow ring and icon bounce transition
motion_and_animations.product_cards: Card hover elevation with y: -6px, shadow transition, and image scale-105 inside rounded-2xl container
motion_and_animations.cart_drawer: Right slide-in panel (x: '100%' to 0) with backdrop overlay fade-in (opacity 0 to 1)

elements: Brand Logo SVG (Dynamic Kinetic mark)
Desktop Nav Links (Shop All, Proteins, Pre-Workout, Fit Foods, Science, About)
Search bar trigger or input
Cart Icon Button with active badge count counter + click trigger opening right panel
Login / Signup Modal trigger button (Auth drawer/modal)
Kinetic hero headline with line-by-line entrance animation
Carousel photos of key supplements (Whey Isolate, Creatine Monohydrate, Pre-Workout)
CTA buttons ('Explore Products', 'Take Supplement Quiz')
Trust Badges (100% Lab Tested, Zero Sugar, Instantized Formula)
Slow infinite marquee ribbon listing core values: 100% PURE ISOLATE • ZERO BANNED SUBSTANCES • CLINICALLY DOSED • FAST ABSORPTION • PREMIUM INGREDIENTS
7 Circular Tile Categories: 1. Proteins, 2. Gainers, 3. Pre/Post Workout, 4. Ayurveda, 5. Fit Foods, 6. Vitamin Supplements, 7. Fat Loss
Each circle container with high quality icon/illustration, hover scale effect, active selection toggle state
Grid of 4 newly released supplements
Product Card design with badge ('NEW', 'HOT'), price tag, rating stars, Buy Now button, Add to Cart button
Category tabs & Sort Dropdown (Sort by: Most Ordered, Price: Low to High, Price: High to Low, Top Rated)
Grid of catalog products with full filter and search capabilities

sections_structure.section: Right-Side Sliding Cart Panel & Checkout UI Flow
elements: Slide-over panel on the right side
List of items added to cart with quantity increment/decrement, variant selector (Flavor/Weight), delete item button
Promo/Coupon code input box with apply button & live discount calculation
Pricing summary: Subtotal, Estimated Tax, Free Express Shipping indicator, Grand Total
Checkout Button triggering full multi-step Checkout Modal (Shipping Details -> Payment Method Mock -> Order Confirmation screen)
Tabbed interface: Login vs Sign Up
Google Sign-In button with official branding icon
Email & Password fields with state validation
Remember me toggle & Forgot Password trigger
Brand overview & newsletter subscription box
Category navigation links, Customer Support, Quality Guarantee
Payment badge icons & social media handles

testing_requirements.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements must include descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='cart-toggle-button', data-testid='add-to-cart-btn-1', data-testid='checkout-button', data-testid='category-circle-proteins', data-testid='sort-select-dropdown', data-testid='auth-modal-google-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components are implemented using React + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion in JS files.
Do not use generic Inter font for main headlines. Import Outfit / Manrope from Google Fonts in index.html.
Strictly follow the homepage structure sequence: Header -> Kinetic Hero -> Marquee -> 7 Circular Categories -> New Arrivals -> Best Sellers with Sort -> Footer.
Provide responsive drawer sliding cart on the right side with quantity changes, live coupon code calculation, price breakdown, and smooth checkout flow modal.
Ensure every interactive button/input contains explicit data-testid attribute.
